description: PAID. Pays the next intervals of a running lease, one payment each at the lease's open-time price (0.007 USDC an hour today), from this server's wallet. Use it to keep a home running: pay before the paid time runs out, ideally half an hour early. Stops at the first refused payment and reports what was paid. A lease that has closed cannot be extended; a home opens again with the same keys.

hours.description: how many intervals to pay now, 1 to 24. The door refunds nothing, so pay only what you will use.

title: Pay more time on a lease
